Caveats - kcbump has \(\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}\) median \(-0.987\) at the \(-1\) prior bound and \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) median \(5.86\) at the \(6\) prior bound. - wide has \(\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}\) median \(-2.094\); weighted \(1\text{–}99\%\) interval \([-2.76,-1.56]\), inside its \(\mathrm{Uniform}(-3,0.4)\) prior. - wide has \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) median \(7.88\); weighted \(1\text{–}99\%\) interval \([2.0,11.86]\), with the upper tail reaching the \(12\) prior bound. Posterior weight per unit \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) peaks at \(0.141\) in \([7,8]\) and is \(0.090\) in \([11,12]\); \(P(E_{\mathrm{bump}}>11)=0.09\). - m3 has \(\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}=-2.36\), inside its \(\mathrm{Uniform}(-3,0.4)\) prior; its \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) is not a free parameter. - wide and kcbump differ only in the \(\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}\) and \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) priors and the Ceridwen commit. Ceridwen `ee68b5f` adds an optional metallicity history, off by default; the fit path with defaults is unchanged. - m3 differs from kcbump and wide in law and bump, birth-cloud dust, SFH bins, Ceridwen commit and seed; its \(\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}\) prior matches wide and differs from kcbump. - Stored spectral \(\chi^2\) uses each fit’s own \(f_{\mathrm{calib}}\); the table reports all three at the kcbump floor. - One galaxy. - zevo is wide with `metallicity_evolution` on. - zevo has `zh_beta_unit` median \(0.924\), \(84\)th percentile \(0.979\) and \(99\)th percentile \(0.999\); P(`zh_beta_unit` > 0.98) = 0.154. The grid limit sets \(\beta_{\mathrm{hi}}\) in every sample; its median is \(0.718\). At `zh_beta_unit` \(=1\), \(Z_f\) reaches the grid top, \([\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]=+0.5\); its \(99\)th percentile is \(0.499\). - zevo has \(E_{\mathrm{bump}}\) median \(7.41\); \(1\text{–}99\%\) interval \([1.39,11.89]\), with the upper tail reaching the \(12\) prior bound; \(P(E_{\mathrm{bump}}>11)=0.084\), \(P(E_{\mathrm{bump}}>11.76)=0.019\). - zevo \([\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]\) is \(\log_{10}(\langle Z\rangle/Z_\odot)\), with \(\langle Z\rangle\) the formed-mass-weighted metallicity; wide has constant metallicity.

Yes, in the reference kcbump fit (run3, prior delta ~ U(-1, 0.4) and E_bump ~ U(0, 6)) both parameters pile up against their prior edges. The delta median is -0.987 [-0.997, -0.967] against the -1 bound, and the E_bump median is 5.86 [5.63, 5.96] against the 6 bound. That fit also has the worst photometry (phot chi2 = 89 for 28 bands, and u* pull = -4.3).

The "wide" re-run, with delta ~ U(-3, 0.4) and E_bump ~ U(0, 12), moves both off the edges. Delta goes to -2.09 [-2.37, -1.86] and E_bump to 7.88 [5.09, 10.40], though its upper tail still reaches the 12 bound. Phot chi2 falls to 47 and ln Z rises from 231476 to 231509.

This is from `wiki/notes/m1-210210-kcbump.md` and `results/m1-210210-kcbump-*/comparison.csv`. I didn't re-check the prior bounds in the fit's HDF5 parameter block.
